metas.name: 1. The Falcon and the D'ohman
metas.description: Homer befriends a new security guard at the plant; Marge daydreams about being a contestant on "Top Chef."

metas.name: 2. Bart Stops to Smell the Roosevelts
metas.description: When superintendent Chalmers is fired for taking Bart and his friends on an unauthorized field trip, the boys hold the school hostage until he is reinstated.

metas.name: 3. Treehouse of Horror XXII
metas.description: A boulder traps Homer's arm when he takes a drive through a canyon; a spider bite paralyzes Homer; Flanders becomes a vigilante by night; Bart and Milhouse travel to a distant planet to obtain an extract.

metas.name: 4. Replaceable You
metas.description: Lisa's science fair project is overshadowed by Bart's mechanical baby seal; Homer's new assistant ends up stealing his job.

metas.name: 5. The Food Wife
metas.description: Marge, Bart and Lisa start their own food blog and land a reservation at a popular restaurant; when Marge sends Homer to a cooking lab, he finds himself in a situation with law enforcement.

metas.name: 6. The Book Job
metas.description: Homer creates a team, including author Neil Gaiman, to write the next hit "tween" book; after receiving an advance copy of the work from his publisher, Homer learns there's more to the business than he imagined.

metas.name: 7. The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
metas.description: The Simpsons host a party to promote Krusty's own brand of liquor; impressed with the party's sucess, Mr. Burns decides to promote Homer; Bart takes an interest in reading classic novels.

metas.name: 8. The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
metas.description: After Krusty the Clown's show is canceled and his talent agency drops him, his very first agent, Annie, tries to craft his comeback.

metas.name: 9. Holidays of Future Passed
metas.description: Thirty years in the future, Bart, Lisa and their children spend the holidays at Marge and Homer's house.

metas.name: 10. Politically Inept, with Homer Simpson
metas.description: After a video of Homer ranting goes viral, he gets his own political talk show; Homer endorses rocker Ted Nugent for the Republican presidential nominee.

metas.name: 11. The D'oh-cial Network
metas.description: Lisa is called to trial after her online social networking site creates dysfunction in the community; Patty and Selma compete in a rowing event.

metas.name: 12. Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
metas.description: Moe's bar rag explains that he started as a medieval tapestry a thousand years earlier; Bart tries to reconcile with Milhouse; the disappearance of Moe's bar rag makes him realize he has friends.

metas.name: 13. The Daughter Also Rises
metas.description: Marge and Lisa's plans for a mother-daughter Valentine's Day take a turn when Lisa falls head over heels for an intellectual romantic; Bart and Milhouse investigate Springfield Elementary's legends.

metas.name: 14. At Long Last Leave
metas.description: When the Simpsons are kicked out of Springfield, they join an off-the-grid community near by; Homer and Marge's former friends react badly when they try to sneak back into town.

metas.name: 15. Exit Through the Kwik-E-Mart
metas.description: When Bart decides to get back at Homer by becoming a graffiti artist, established street artists offer him a gallery show; a new health food store threatens to put Apu out of business.

metas.name: 16. How I Wet Your Mother
metas.description: When Homer's bed-wetting worsens, his family tries to infiltrate his dreams to find the source of the problem.

metas.name: 17. Them, Robot
metas.description: When Mr. Burn replaces most of the plant's employees with robots that end up turning on the community, the people he laid off must come to the rescue.

metas.name: 18. Beware My Cheating Bart
metas.description: Bart ends up in trouble with school bullies after Jimbo's girlfriend develops feelings for him; Homer buys a treadmill equipped with a TV.

metas.name: 19. A Totally Fun Thing That Bart Will Never Do Again
metas.description: When Bart gets his wish for a family vacation, he becomes determined to make it last forever.

metas.name: 20. The Spy Who Learned Me
metas.description: Marge and Homer go on a date, but Marge is embarrassed when Homer talks during the movie; when Homer gets hurt and can't work, he tries to learn how to be a better husband from a man he believes is a movie star.

metas.name: 21. Ned 'n Edna's Blend Agenda
metas.description: When Marge learns Ned and Edna got married, she offers to throw them a reception; Edna changes some rules to help Ned's kids become more socially acceptable.

metas.name: 22. Lisa Goes Gaga
metas.description: Lisa tries to make herself more popular by writing good things about herself on the school blog, but the plan backfires; Lisa helps Lady Gaga and learns the importance of being yourself.
